UnitStatement: App.tsx imports feature panel components (AccessibilityBaseline, AdapterFramework, AgentProposal, BuildReadiness, CaepipeExternalHarness, and many others) from ./features/* subpackages.

App imports preview services: buildAnalysisRunPreview, buildPreviewComparison, cancelPreviewMechanicsJob, loadDesignKnowledge, loadPreviewModel, runPreviewMechanics, and start/poll preview mechanics job functions from ./services/previewService.
App imports operation engine services: applyModelOperation, validateModelOperation, warmupOperationEngine, and initialOperationEngineStatus from ./services/operationService.
App imports local project services: buildBlankLocalModelDocument, createLocalProject, getLocalStorageCapability, listLocalProjects, openLocalProject, saveLocalProject from ./services/projectService.
App imports computeModelHash and computeProjectEnvelopeHash from ./services/hashService for model and envelope integrity hashing.
SessionModelCheckpoint type captures checkpoint_id, operation_id, model (PreviewModel) and selection (EntityRef) for undo/redo session history.

Workspace information architecture (TP-APP-R2-UXSHELL-001): persistent spatial core (model tree, 3D centerline viewport, property inspector) stays on screen; all other panels sit behind section navigation listed in A12 journey order (model entities -> loads -> solve -> results -> report).

Rule-pack manager (Phase C2, TP-C2-EDITOR-001) is placed between loads and solve because user rule checks consume authored loads and feed the solve/check journey (PRD section 22.4); the private library manager (Phase C3, TP-C3-LIBGUI-001) precedes it because both are private local-only asset managers and rule packs reference imported library allowables.
WorkspaceSectionId union enumerates the dock sections: operations, loads, libraries, rule-packs, solve, results, report, project, exports, evidence.
WORKSPACE_SECTIONS constant defines each dock section's id, label, and description (e.g. operations = queued structured operations apply/undo/redo and review ledger).
Libraries section description: private, local-only library manager importing material/section/component libraries with provenance, validation findings, and the local store.
Rule-packs section description: private, local-only rule-pack manager with drafts, validation findings, checksum generation, and the local store.

JourneyStepId union and JourneyStep type model the guided journey rail steps (model, loads, private-libraries, rule-pack, solve-check, results, report, save-reopen) each bound to a WorkspaceSectionId.

A12FlowStepId union and A12FlowStep type model the A12 authoring flow steps (blank, nodes, material, section, pipe, support, load-case, primitive-load, combination, solve, report, save-reopen) with cue, complete and status fields.
GuidedJourneyMode union ('a12' | 'r3') selects between A12 authoring journey and R3 rule-check journey.
R3FlowStepId union and R3FlowStep type model the R3 rule-pack flow steps: library, rule-pack, checksum-save, solve, bind, run.

R3JourneyEvent union enumerates recordable R3 journey events (library_template_loaded, library_validate_requested, rule_pack_draft_created, rule_pack_checksum_requested, rule_check_run_requested, etc.); R3JourneyState is a Record mapping each event to a boolean.
INITIAL_R3_JOURNEY_STATE initializes every R3 journey event flag to false.
JOURNEY_STEPS constant lists the eight guided journey steps with id, label, section, and description in journey order.

App() is the root React component holding session state via useState: model, knowledge, selection, result, analysisRun, ruleCheckAggregate, proposal, editorIntents, project summary/index, hashes, migration ledger, solveJob, and UI flags.
ruleCheckAggregate state holds the worst-of GUI rule-check aggregate, lifted so it can be recorded in the app-held analysis-run envelope (TP-C4-APPAGG-001).
comparison is memoized via buildPreviewComparison when both result and analysisRun exist; otherwise null.
On mount, App loads preview model, design knowledge, and local storage capability concurrently (Promise.all) and sets initial selection via defaultSelection.
App recomputes modelHash whenever model changes, clearing the hash first then setting it from computeModelHash.
App warms up the operation engine on mount; browser mode lazily loads the wasm32 operation_applier build, and an absent artifact surfaces as an explicit unavailable status, never a fallback.

handleRun starts a preview mechanics job; a fresh solve invalidates any prior rule-check aggregate; backend_job mode awaits the backend job to a terminal state, browser mode runs preview mechanics inline.
handleRun throws if a backend solve job ends in a non-completed state or without a result, surfacing the backend error message.
On solve completion handleRun builds the analysis-run preview record, completes the solve job, sets result, and clears proposal/review target.

handleRuleCheckAggregate records (or clears) the GUI rule-check aggregate in the app-held analysis-run envelope; rebuilding re-derives only the analysis_run_record status/hash, while the embedded result_envelope hash still binds the raw solve, so the hash-bound solve envelope is never mutated.
If recording the rule-check aggregate fails (e.g. hashing unavailable), handleRuleCheckAggregate keeps the solve-time analysis-run envelope rather than surfacing a false outcome.
recordR3JourneyEvent idempotently sets an R3 journey event flag to true, ignoring already-set events.
handleCancelRun requests solve cancellation; for tauri backend jobs it calls cancelPreviewMechanicsJob with the backend cancellation token and records the receipt or failure.
handleProposal loads a sample agent proposal scoped to the current result and selected review target.
handleQueueEditorIntent assigns a monotonic queue_id (editor-intent-N) and prepends the intent to the editor intents queue.
handleValidateIntent calls validateModelOperation for a queued intent and records the outcome keyed by intentKey, setting an error message on failure.

handleApplyIntent applies a queued model operation; if application_status is not 'applied_to_session_model' or no applied_model is returned, it reports the operation was not applied and returns without mutating the model.

On successful apply, handleApplyIntent builds an AppliedOperationReceipt recording sequence, operation_id, change_id, target type/ref, field_path, before/after, application_route, applied_model_hash, acceptance, diagnostics, and professional_boundary.
handleApplyIntent pushes an undo checkpoint (capped at 25), clears the redo stack, sets the applied model, and resolves the next selection (default selection on delete operations).

After applying an operation, prior solve output no longer describes the edited model document, so result/analysisRun/ruleCheckAggregate/proposal/review target are cleared and the user is told to run a new solve then save.
handleUndoSessionModelEdit pops the undo stack, pushes a redo checkpoint, restores the checkpoint model and selection, and clears computed model state (solve still required to persist).
handleRedoSessionModelEdit pops the redo stack, pushes an undo checkpoint, restores the model/selection, and clears computed model state.
clearComputedModelState resets result, analysisRun, ruleCheckAggregate, proposal, and selectedReviewTarget and installs the provided next solve job.

handleCreateProject computes the project envelope hash then createLocalProject persists model, editor intents, proposal, review target, result, analysisRun, modelHash, and envelopeHash, updating summary and migration ledger.
handleCreateBlankProject builds a blank local model document with no fixture entities or external file copies, persists it, and resets all session/edit/result state.

handleOpenProject opens a local project by id (or default); if none found it reports open_missing; otherwise it restores model/result/analysisRun/intents and recomputes model and envelope hash integrity on open.
On open, handleOpenProject derives model-hash integrity and project-envelope-hash integrity by recomputing hashes from the restored model and comparing against the persisted values.
handleSaveProject computes the envelope hash and saveLocalProject persists model, intents, proposal, review target, result, analysisRun, modelHash, envelopeHash, and modelDocumentMigration.
handleListProjects lists local project snapshots from the local store index and reports the count.
handleSelectResult sets the selected review target to a result and resolves the entity selection via resolveEntitySelection.
handleSelectDiagnostic sets the selected review target to a diagnostic and resolves the entity selection via resolveDiagnosticEntitySelection.
App renders a loading screen ('Loading local OpenPipeStress preview fixture') until model and selection are available.
App shell renders a topbar with preview status badges: Invented data, Local execution, storage capability, and Human review required.
Project toolbar exposes Create local, New blank, Open local, List local, and Save local buttons, plus per-project open buttons from the project index.
Local project status line surfaces storage engine, network_required, daemon_required, telemetry_enabled, and FTS5 availability from the storage capability.
Boundary strip displays four preview boundaries from model.data_boundary: public_examples_policy, protected_source_policy, private_data_policy, and professional_boundary.
Modeling workspace renders the persistent spatial core: ModelTree, PipeViewport (with queue-intent/select handlers), and PropertyInspector.
Workspace dock renders the GuidedWorkbench plus a section nav and the dock body containing one section per WorkspaceSectionId.
Operations dock section renders OperationApplyPanel and a collapsible review-apply drawer with EditorContractPanel, DiffPreviewPanel, OperationLedgerPanel, and AgentProposalPanel.
Solve dock section renders SolvePanel, DiagnosticsPanel, MissingDataBlockingPanel, RuleCheckPanel, RuleCheckRunPanel (wired to handleRuleCheckAggregate and recordR3JourneyEvent), and KnowledgePanel.

Exports dock section renders result/stress-neutral/PCF/CAEPIPE-MBF/CAEPIPE-external exports, export-adapter-SDK, adapter-framework, local-FEA handoff, external-prover boundary, review-geometry, headless-runner, native-package, handoff, and export-review panels.

Evidence (Audit & Boundaries) dock section renders RunAuditPanel, ValidationEvidencePanel, BuildReadinessPanel, TelemetryBoundaryPanel, SecretPrivateLibraryPanel, SecurityThreatModelPanel, and AccessibilityBaselinePanel.
App footer disclaimer: technical preview only; no production-readiness, release-readiness, certification, sealing, code-compliance, or licensed engineering reliance claim.

Inactive dock sections stay mounted (form drafts, queue previews, audit state survive navigation) and are hidden with CSS only; display:none also removes them from the accessibility tree in a real browser.
dockSectionClass returns 'workspace-dock-section' for the active section and adds 'inactive' otherwise.
GuidedWorkbench component renders the journey rail, current-step panel, and the A12/R3 guided journey selector based on guidedJourneyMode.
GuidedWorkbench surfaces the R3 exit-journey status alongside the current step status.
A12AuthoringJourney component renders the A12 authoring flow with next-action cue, progress, step grid, and a review/apply-or-advance action button.
A12 action section: when intents are queued the action targets the operations section, otherwise the next incomplete step's section.
a12StepClass builds CSS classes for an A12 step adding 'complete', 'next', and 'selected' modifiers based on completion, next-step, and active-step state.

buildA12FlowState derives A12 authoring progress from the model: counts materials, sections, combinations, and primitive loads; solved = result has rows and mechanics status MECHANICS_SOLVED; reportReady requires solved plus analysisRun.
buildA12FlowState treats projectOperation 'open'/'open_by_id' as reopened and 'save' or reopened as saved for the save/reopen step.

buildA12FlowState defines the twelve ordered A12 steps (blank, nodes, material, section, pipe, support, load-case, primitive-load, combination, solve, report, save-reopen) with per-step completion predicates against model counts.
buildA12FlowState returns completedCount, nextStep (first incomplete), a queueStatus summary of pending operations, and the steps array.
operationIntentDisplayRef extracts a display id from the intent's after-payload JSON id when present, falling back to the target ref for non-JSON after-values.
isBlankAuthoringModel detects a blank user-created local document by checking public_examples_policy for 'blank_user_created_local_document'.
countStatus returns 'done' when actual >= required, otherwise 'actual/required'.
R3GuidedJourney component renders the R3 rule-pack guided flow with next-action cue, progress, step grid, a missing-input blocker line, and a navigate action.

buildR3FlowState derives R3 progress: solved from result; libraryTouched requires template loaded plus validate-or-save; packValidated requires draft created plus validate; packSaved requires checksum plus save; runAttempted from aggregate or run requested.
buildR3FlowState defines the six R3 steps (library, rule-pack, checksum-save, solve, bind, run) with completion predicates and per-step human-readable status strings.
R3 'bind' step is complete when rule_check_pack_loaded is set, showing 'binding plan visible'; the 'run' step is complete when a check run was attempted.
buildR3FlowState returns completedCount, nextStep, a composite status string (private library/rule_pack/checksum_save/rule_check states), and the steps array.
r3StepClass builds CSS classes for an R3 step adding 'complete', 'next', and 'selected' modifiers.
r3MissingInputBlockerText: missing inputs block pass/fail when aggregate is RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.
r3MissingInputBlockerText: missing-input gate is pending until a rule pack is loaded and required values are bound before pass/fail.
r3MissingInputBlockerText: when a run is requested, the browser preview keeps pass/fail blocked until the desktop checker returns complete inputs.
r3MissingInputBlockerText labels a resolved aggregate as a software finding only, with no code-compliance claim.
journeyStepIcon maps each JourneyStepId to a lucide-react icon node.
journeyStepStatus computes a per-journey-step status label (current/queued/solved/rows/after-solve/local/not-saved) from active section, intents, result, analysisRun, and project summary.

currentJourneyStep returns the title/body/status for the active workspace section, describing what the user should do in each section (operations, loads, libraries, rule-packs, solve, results, report, project, exports, evidence).

Rule-packs current-step body: drafts are created/validated/checksummed/saved through the structured composer; writable expression text remains out of scope under DEC-037 (AST composer only, no text parser).
Solve current-step body: run mechanics first, then review missing rule-check inputs; missing inputs block pass/fail instead of being guessed.
Report current-step body: reports are hash-bound and disclose assumptions, warnings, provenance, and boundary status without professional approval claims.
Project current-step body: user-created models remain local project data and are not committed to the repository.
r3ExitJourneyStatus reports that the packaged A12/R3 human pass is not recorded, journey evidence is started/incomplete, and the R3 exit review has not started.
Badge component renders an icon plus label span.
BoundaryItem renders a labeled code value; the title attribute carries the full value when the strip ellipsizes at narrow widths.
boundaryValue reads model.data_boundary[key], returning 'TBD' when absent.
storageBadgeLabel returns 'SQLite + FTS5' when FTS5 is available, 'Local preview store' for browser engines, else 'Local store'.
projectReviewContext summarizes pending review context: total pending operations, applied_operations count, editor_intents count, and agent_proposals count.
selectionForOperationOutcome maps an operation outcome's target_object_type (Material/Section/Node/Element/Component/Support/Load/Combination) to an EntityRef type and ref, or null.
clonePreviewModel deep-clones a PreviewModel via JSON parse/stringify.
NO_BACKEND_JOB_TOKEN constant ('none_no_active_backend_job') marks the absence of an active backend cancellation token.
initialSolveJob returns the not-started SolveJobAuditState: progress basis is preview-service event-state only with no percent stream, percentages never synthesized, and no backend job seam.

startSolveJob builds the running SolveJobAuditState; backend_job mode notes cooperative cancellation at backend checkpoints and that this service path does not stream percentage progress; browser mode runs without a backend job.
modelChangedSolveJob produces a not-started solve job noting previous mechanics results were cleared because the applied structured operation changed the model.
blankProjectCreatedSolveJob produces a not-started solve job noting no mechanics results exist until explicit entities and loads are added and a solve is run.
sessionHistoryChangedSolveJob produces a not-started solve job after undo/redo, noting previous mechanics results were cleared because they no longer describe the current model.
awaitBackendSolveJob polls pollPreviewMechanicsJob every 50ms while the job is queued or running, returning the terminal status.
cancelledSolveJob records a cancelled state with the cancellation_status; the backend job stopped at a cooperative checkpoint with no result published and no cancellation-success guarantee claimed.
recordBackendCancellationReceipt appends a cancel-receipt event capturing accepted flag, cancellation_status, and job_state, claiming no cancellation success.
recordBackendCancellationFailure records 'backend_cancellation_request_failed' when the cancel request fails to reach the job registry; the solve job continues under its own state reporting.

completeSolveJob records completion with result row count and binds the run to the analysis-run run_id; a prior cancellation request that arrived too late is marked request_recorded_run_completed_before_cancellation_took_effect.
restoredSolveJob reconstructs a completed solve job from a persisted run record with progress basis 'restored_persisted_run_record_no_new_solve_executed'; no new solve was executed.
failSolveJob records a failed solve with analysis_status MODEL_INCOMPLETE and HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED and the error message.

requestSolveCancellation transitions a running job to 'cancelling'; backend jobs send the request to the backend job awaiting receipt, browser fixture mode records the request with no backend job to interrupt.
safeJobToken normalizes a value to a lowercase hyphenated token for job ids.

deriveModelHashIntegrity compares a stored model hash against a recomputed hash, returning integrity_status not_persisted, hash_recompute_unavailable, verified_match, or mismatch_review_required, with verification basis 'recomputed_on_open_from_restored_model'.

deriveProjectEnvelopeHashIntegrity compares stored vs recomputed project envelope hash, returning not_persisted / hash_recompute_unavailable / verified_match / mismatch_review_required with basis 'recomputed_on_open_from_restored_envelope_payload'.
AccessibilityBaselinePanel renders the accessibility and usability baseline review section with a JSON export link and summary (surfaces, findings, warnings, target status).

Accessibility baseline note: it is deterministic technical-preview evidence from invented GUI contract records and does not select a final conformance target, run a full desktop accessibility tree audit, mutate engineering data, or create release/professional reliance.
AccessibilityLine renders a labeled report line (label + value) with a test id.
buildAccessibilityBaselinePacket builds the accessibility baseline packet (schema 0.1.0, DEL-07-06, PKG-07, SOW-036, OBJ-006) bound to the project ref.
Accessibility packet source_basis cites core module core/gui/accessibility/engine.py, guard tests tests/test_accessibility_usability_baseline.py, and the reviewed app surfaces.

Accessibility packet summary records 6 source surfaces, 69 total findings (57 pass, 10 warning, 1 fail, 1 not-applicable, 1 blocking, 13 major) plus per-category finding counts; accessibility_target_status is TBD_by_human_project_authority and desktop_runtime_evaluation is not_performed.
Accessibility packet enumerates six source surfaces (DEL-07-01..07-07) via sourceSurface helper.

Accessibility packet reviewed_categories list eleven categories (keyboard_path, focus_order, readable_label, warning_visibility, result_review_visibility, solve_state_feedback, review_workflow_continuity, contrast_readability, source_diagnostic_visibility, professional_boundary, privacy_boundary).

Accessibility review_policy asserts no auto-fill of missing data, no mutation of GUI contract records, preservation of diagnostics/assumptions/provenance/privacy, color-only status signaling not allowed, and software makes no accessibility conformance claim.
Accessibility open_decisions mark conformance target, report accessibility target, automated a11y tooling, screenshot policy, generated report target, and desktop runtime audit all TBD.
sourceSurface helper builds a source surface record (deliverable_id, surface_name, status represented_by_core_gui_contract_fixture).
professionalBoundary (accessibility) asserts human_review_required true and all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claims false.
jsonDataHref encodes a payload as a JSON data: URL for local browser download.
safeFileToken normalizes a value to a lowercase hyphenated token for download filenames.
AdapterFrameworkPanel renders the adapter framework envelope with a JSON export link and a summary of capabilities, parse status, and diagnostics.

Adapter framework note: output is a local format-neutral declaration only; concrete external formats, public transport, plugin runtime, package scripts, CI, release matrix, redaction workflow, and filesystem roots remain TBD.
AdapterLine renders a labeled report line with a test id.
buildAdapterFrameworkPacket builds the adapter framework packet (schema 0.1.0, DEL-10-02, PKG-10, SOW-030, OBJ-009) merging model and result diagnostics.

Adapter declaration: id ops.adapter.desktop_preview, kind format_neutral_contract, format_status TBD, capabilities export_model/export_results/validate_payload/contribution_review, operation boundary ops.export.job (job, metadata_only, transport TBD).

Adapter validation_plan requires schema, unit, dimension, provenance, redistribution, privacy, protected-content, mechanics-readiness, rule-check-readiness, and export review, with syntactic parse not performed by the framework and human_review_required true.

Adapter operation_result records operation class export, parse_status not_parsed_by_framework, diagnostics, privacy, provenance, checksums (run hashes or a TBD checksum), audit manifest refs, and the result-envelope ref (schemas/results.schema.yaml).

frameworkStatus declares a schema_first_format_neutral_adapter_framework interface with external format list, public transport, endpoint syntax, execution model, plugin runtime, permission persistence, project container, FEA package format, redaction workflow, CI provider, and release matrix all TBD.

tbdDecisions enumerates the adapter framework's twelve unresolved decisions (external formats, transport, endpoint syntax, execution model, plugin runtime, permission persistence, package scripts, CI provider, release matrix, project container, FEA package format, redaction workflow).

noBypassControls enumerates mandatory adapter controls: must use public API boundary and unit validation; must preserve provenance, redistribution review, privacy classification, diagnostics, rule-pack sandbox, and persistence hash controls; must route persistence through application services.

noBypassControls forbids exposing SQL/raw SQLite, exposing table names, mutating the project store directly, executing arbitrary code, accessing network, choosing filesystem roots, claiming code compliance, and transmitting private data by default.

adapterDiagnostic normalizes a Diagnostic into the adapter diagnostic shape (code, class, severity with error/blocking folded to blocking, source ref, affected object, message, remediation, provenance).
adapterDiagnosticClass classifies a diagnostic by code/severity into RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, UNIT_WARNING, ADAPTER_BLOCKING, or ASSUMPTION_WARNING.
checksumRef maps an analysis-run hash to a checksum record (algorithm, canonicalization, payload_ref, value).
objectReference builds a payload reference from an ObjectRef as object_type:ref.
tbdChecksum builds a TBD checksum record for a project id when no run hashes exist.
reference builds a typed {ref_type, ref_id} reference for adapter framework payloads.
privacyContext declares export_review_required classification, local_first true, telemetry disallowed, export review required, and private payload redacted.
professionalBoundary (adapter) asserts human review required, mechanics-solve and user-rule-check distinct, and all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/security-certification claims false.
previewProvenance (adapter) declares an invented preview fixture source (fixtures/product_preview, project-invented license, public_permissive redistribution, accepted review).
noBypassSummary renders a one-line summary of API/units enforcement and the inverse of direct-SQL/network/code-compliance-claim flags.
adapterBoundarySummary renders a one-line privacy/boundary summary (local_first, telemetry, private_redacted) noting no compliance/certification/sealing/approval/security-certification claim.
AgentProposalPanel renders the agentic proposal panel with a 'Generate review proposal' button disabled until mechanicsReady, since review proposals are generated against solve results.
AgentProposalPanel shows the selected review target (type and id) when one is selected.

When a proposal exists, the panel renders its id, rationale, operation summary (operation id/kind/status/affected entities), validation status, change diffs, audit boundary, and professional boundary.
Accept-proposal action is disabled and review-only until accepted mutation is implemented.
With no proposal, the panel notes local proposal examples are deterministic and review-only.
ProposalFact renders a labeled fact (label + value) with optional test id.
ProposalFlag renders a labeled boolean flag styled true/false.
formatKey replaces underscores with spaces for human-readable labels.
ROOT_SCRIPTS constant lists root npm scripts: dev:desktop, build:desktop, test:desktop, generate:product-preview-mechanics.
DESKTOP_SCRIPTS constant lists desktop package scripts: dev, build, test, tauri.
READINESS_PROFILES constant lists release readiness profiles: skeleton, python, security, cargo, all.
BuildReadinessPanel renders the build/package readiness section with a JSON export link and a summary of script count, tauri shell status, bundle active flag, and diagnostics.
Build readiness note: it is local technical-preview evidence only and does not select CI, publish packages, sign binaries, authorize release, or make professional/code-compliance claims.
BuildReadinessLine renders a labeled report line with a test id.
buildReadinessPacket builds the build/package readiness packet (schema 0.1.0, DEL-10-04, PKG-10, SOW-032, OBJ-008/OBJ-009) bound to the project ref.

Build readiness source_basis cites governance docs (BUILD_AND_RELEASE, RELEASE_QUALITY_GATES, VALIDATION_STRATEGY, IP_AND_DATA_BOUNDARY), manifests (package.json, desktop package.json, Cargo.toml), tauri.conf.json, and tools/release/check_release_readiness.py.

Build readiness summary: status local_preview_build_package_surface_available, script count from ROOT+DESKTOP scripts, tauri shell present (major version 2), bundle inactive, release not authorized, CI provider and release matrix TBD.

Build readiness workspace block records root package openpipestress-workspace 0.1.0, desktop package @openpipestress/desktop (private, module type), plus desktop dependencies (tauri api, vite, three, react) and dev dependencies (tauri cli, testing-library, vitest, typescript).

Build readiness tauri_shell block records product OpenPipeStress Technical Preview 0.1.0, identifier org.openpipestress.technical-preview, dev/build commands, dev_url 127.0.0.1:5173, window dimensions, CSP TBD (null in preview config), bundle inactive, and TBD installer/signing/notarization.

Build readiness release_readiness_tool block records the check_release_readiness.py command and --execute variant, default profile skeleton, profiles list, and that the browser panel does not run the tool, dry-run defaults true, no external services, no shell command evaluation.

Build readiness unresolved_decisions mark CI provider, hosted workflow location, release matrix, installer formats, signing/notarization, checksum publication, release attestation, publishing, coverage/performance thresholds, maintainer quorum, and release authority all TBD.

Build readiness diagnostics: provider-neutral metadata visible (info), tauri bundle.active false so no installer/binary claim (warning), release decisions TBD (warning), and desktop tranches still require local npm test/build and smoke evidence outside the browser panel (info).

Build readiness boundary asserts local-only preview, no network/daemon/telemetry, no private/protected payload, release publication not authorized, no installer/binary generated, no source model mutation, and no code-compliance or professional-reliance claim.
diagnostic helper builds a build-readiness diagnostic (code, severity info/warning, message, source file).
professionalBoundary (build readiness) asserts human review required and all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claims false.
CaePipeExternalReference type holds {object_type, ref} for CAEPIPE external payload references.

CaePipeExternalCsvRow type models a parsed CAEPIPE CSV row: row_number, section (NODE_DISPLACEMENTS | ELEMENT_FORCES), stable_id, target_id, load_case, unit, values map, correlation_status 'canonical_id_map', source csv ref, and provenance.

CAEPIPE external constants: version 0.1.0; HASH_STATUS_TBD (browser preview does not emit a canonical package hash); SCHEMA_VALIDATION_STATUS (shape aligned, not runtime JSON-schema validated); invocation profile and configuration surface TBDs.
CaepipeExternalHarnessPanel renders the CAEPIPE external harness panel with JSON and parser-CSV export links and a summary (status, rows, sections, external_invoked flag, diagnostics).

CAEPIPE external note: output is parser-only browser preview evidence; executable path, license responsibility, environment responsibility, invocation profile, live execution, and target compatibility remain user-owned or TBD.
CaePipeExternalLine renders a labeled report line with a test id.

buildCaePipeExternalHarnessPacket builds the CAEPIPE external run package (schema 0.1.0, DEL-17-05, PKG-17, SOW-030/046/075, OBJ-007/009/017/018) binding the MBF package, model state, analysis run, and result refs.
CAEPIPE external package_status is parser_only_evidence; the MBF package ref binds the DEL-17-04 CAEPIPE-MBF export.
CAEPIPE external executable_config records configuration surface TBD, configured_path_state absent, license and environment responsibility not acknowledged, and path_record not_configured.
CAEPIPE external command_profile records invocation profile TBD, invocation_mode parser_only_not_invoked, and command_shape not_invoked_public_browser_fixture_only.
CAEPIPE external run_directory records the fixture working directory, input MBF download path, expected and observed CSV paths, and output_discovery_status fixture_generated_browser_preview.
CAEPIPE external execution_result records attempted false, no exit status, no stdout/stderr capture, and skip_reason that external CAEPIPE execution was not attempted (parser-only preview).

CAEPIPE external validation_report records validation_status (blocked if any blocking diagnostic, else boundary_checked), schema/hash validation status, row/section counts, correlation_status canonical_id_map, a checks list, and human_review_required true.

CAEPIPE external validation checks assert external execution not attempted, executable configuration absent, MBF package bound to DEL-17-04, parser rows present and canonical-id-mapped, and no professional or compatibility claims.

CAEPIPE external boundary_notes: external execution is optional and user-owned; the preview does not configure/discover/invoke/bundle/download/install/license CAEPIPE; parsed rows are invented parser-only evidence asserting no compatibility/solver-validation/release/compliance/professional-reliance.
CAEPIPE external privacy block: invented_public_example classification, local_only, telemetry disallowed, and no private/protected/commercial-tool payload embedded.
CAEPIPE external data_boundary asserts no private payload, no protected content, no commercial tool payload, and no copied commercial solver file included.
parsedCsvPackage assembles the parser-only CSV package (source csv ref, parser_status parsed_parser_only_fixture, row count, rows, and a TBD csv checksum over normalized ASCII LF text).
parserRows builds invented parser-only CSV rows by sorting nodes/pipes/load-cases by id and emitting up to two NODE_DISPLACEMENTS rows and one ELEMENT_FORCES row mapped to canonical ids.
csvRow constructs a CaePipeExternalCsvRow with correlation_status canonical_id_map and preview provenance.
parserCoverage declares supported sections ELEMENT_FORCES and NODE_DISPLACEMENTS with expected columns, parser_only_supported status, and a diagnostic_warning unmapped-row policy.
caepipeExternalDiagnostics emits a blocking CAEPIPE-EXTERNAL-PARSER-NO-ROWS diagnostic when no rows are produced, otherwise no diagnostics.
check helper builds a validation check record (check_id, pass/fail status, provenance).
checksum helper builds a TBD CAEPIPE external checksum record over a run member payload scope (browser preview does not emit a canonical package hash).
renderCsv serializes parser rows to CSV text with header section,stable_id,target_id,load_case,ux,uy,uz,axial,shear_y,shear_z,unit and LF line endings.
csvValue quotes a CSV field containing quotes, commas, or newlines, doubling embedded quotes.
reference helper builds a CaePipeExternalReference {object_type, ref}.

professionalBoundaryIsClear returns true only when every CAEPIPE professional-boundary claim flag is false (no bundling, auto-invocation, or release/compatibility/solver/compliance claims).
previewProvenance (CAEPIPE external) declares invented parser-only metadata with no CAEPIPE executable, commercial output, protected standards, or private project payloads, review_status pending.
